tier: App Automate - Device Cloud (1 parallel test)

free_tier.stated: 100 minutes of automated mobile application testing on different mobile devices, given at signup as part of the BrowserStack Free Trial; not a recurring monthly allowance. The signup page also lists 100 mins of automated mobile app testing among what is included.
free_tier.notes: one-time trial allowance of 100 minutes, not a monthly pool; the signup FAQ on the free trial is the page that states the number

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a hosted test device session, not a stored object

retention.stated: not published on the pages read: the App Automate page and the trial FAQ state no retention period for test logs, videos or screenshots

egress.terms: not published on the pages read: the pricing page, the product page and the trial FAQ state no egress allowance or price for device sessions

interface_detail: Automated mobile app tests driven by Appium, Espresso, XCUITest and EarlGrey against physical iOS and Android devices; REST API to mark statuses and fetch session logs; vendor SDK and CI/CD integrations.
tooling: Appium, Espresso, XCUITest and EarlGrey test suites with BrowserStack SDKs and a REST API; integrations with Jenkins, GitHub, GitLab, CircleCI, Jira and Slack; no rclone or generic shell access, the device is reached through the test automation frameworks.
chaining: A hosted real-device lab for running mobile test suites in CI without owning handsets; 100 free minutes at signup sizes a first suite, and at scale the 1-parallel device tier costs USD 199 a month billed annually, so the paid tier is a subscription rather than a per-minute meter.

limits.value: 100 minutes of automated mobile app testing in the Free Trial, a one-time allowance rather than a recurring monthly pool
1 parallel test at USD 199 per month billed annually; the pricing page lists 1, 2 and 5 parallel-test tiers but publishes no per-tier price above 1 parallel test

limits_note: Access is by concurrent App Automate sessions, not by a per-minute meter on the paid tier; unlimited testing minutes are listed as included in the paid device plans.
binding_note: The 100 trial minutes are spent once and do not renew, so that one-time allowance is what runs out first before any paid subscription begins.

identity_cost.detail: unverified: the sign-up page offers only 'Sign up with Google' and role and discovery dropdowns; no email field, email, card or phone text appears on it, and an original and a fresh read of the page both showed only Google OAuth. The email/password form is rendered by JavaScript and is not in the captured text, so the exact identifier gate is not established from the sign-up page. The sign-in page does show 'Enter your business email' and 'Enter your password' for an existing account, but that is not a sign-up gate.

reliability_note: No reliability event observed on the pages read; the trial allowance is a one-time 100 minutes and the page gives no SLA for the free trial.
confidence_note: The trial minutes, the App Automate tier price and the signup gate were read from first-party BrowserStack pages on 2026-11-25; the price came from the pricing page's plan comparison table.

notes: A hosted real-device cloud for mobile app automation: Appium, Espresso, XCUITest and EarlGrey tests run on physical iOS and Android devices. The free trial is 100 one-time minutes of App Automate, not a recurring allowance; the paid App Automate Device Cloud tier is USD 199 a month billed annually for one parallel device test, and the next listed tier is USD 249 a month billed annually. No general-purpose shell VM is offered; the compute is a managed device session. The signup page's only visible identity gate is OAuth; an email-and-password field appears on the sign-in page, but the exact registration identifier is not established from the sign-up capture.
